caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, with all four legs visible. The chair features a light brown woven cane seat, and its wooden frame is painted in dark brown with visible yellowish decorative accents. The backrest consists of three horizontal rods and multiple narrow vertical spindles. The legs and frame of the chair are slender and designed to resemble bamboo, with rounded nodes. The background is plain and a light cream color, with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The artist's signature, "Ralph M. Morton, Del: 550," is visible in small print at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Chair
